heading: Island shape lab
hint: Compares seeds and generation parameters side by side using the same worldGenerator.ts port the game runs client-side — nothing here calls the backend.
docsIntro: Each island's shape is a chain of 'lobes' (offset discs) built along a bending spine, then softened by a coastline warp. The old defaults kept the spine so short that lobes barely left the envelope disc's own footprint, so islands still read as round circles. The current defaults de-round that shape with longer, bendier spines and a stronger warp.
docsFields: Island min/max lobes: how many discs the spine chains together. Island max elongation: how far the spine can stretch relative to the island's own radius. Island bendiness: how much the spine curves rather than running straight. Island lobe blend: how smoothly neighbouring lobes merge (lower = more distinct bumps). Island lobe min/max scale: how much smaller a lobe can be than the one before it (headlands/islets). Island coast warp / coast warp scale: the amplitude and wavelength of the noise that roughens the coastline.
docsBudget: The backend rejects a parameter set whose shape could reach further than the grid cell it's seeded in allows (see WorldGenerationOptions.Validate's reach-budget check) — Island cell size is the knob that buys more room when raising the shape fields above.
